answer: Reputation Decay Curve. Each identity's standing loses a fixed fraction per idle period, so a plume of fresh accounts must keep earning or sink. Enforcement: matchmaking slots scale with decayed score, forcing every sybil to sustain real work output. A pearl of high trust takes months to rebuild after any lapse. Attack cost is the ongoing labor plus a velvet opportunity tax: each fake identity ties up capacity it cannot resell, so N sybils cost N times the maintenance labor every cycle.
